notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 If Available ownership-acquisition service. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies unavailable and successful acquisition callbacks, exact object and attribute metadata, tag preservation, ownership-state transitions, repeat-acquisition rejection, and federation cleanup. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador publication, subscription, object registration, If Available acquisition, unconditional divestiture, ownership status, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador discovery, ownership-acquisition, and ownership-unavailable callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-acquisition declarations
